text: Hi all, the delivery arrives Thursday at the Docklands depot, then goes to Room 204 in Building C. Please confirm the Bay 5 slot. Thanks, the Front Desk team
Hello team, the Falcon release is delayed, so please update the Sprint Board and notify Customer Care. Excel files are in the shared drive. Regards, IT Support
Quick reminder: the Q3 Offsite moves to Thursday, and Project Bluebird demos run all Friday. March invoices are due before the Town Hall. Thanks, the Ops Team
Please confirm the May deadline and check the bill of materials before the grace period ends. We will send a firm quote soon. Regards, the Billing Team
The duty manager approved our leave requests, and the new hire starts Monday. Our landlord will send the invoice to the accountant. Best, the HR team

Hi everyone, the inspection team will meet at the Northgate office before heading to the Cedar Lane site. Parking is limited near Market Square, so please use the garage on Riverside Drive. The Annex entrance stays locked after six. Kind regards, Facilities

Hello, Northwind Logistics switched carriers, so update the tracking template in Sheets and flag anything over fifty pounds for the Dispatch Team. The Kestrel release notes are on the wiki, and the Service Desk will handle refund questions. Best, the Warehouse Crew

Good morning, the Winter Social is confirmed for Friday, December 12, right after the All-Hands. Project Sandpiper reviews shift to Tuesday mornings, and the Thanksgiving potluck signup sheet is posted near Reception. Orientation Week materials are due before the January audit. Thanks, the Events Committee

Please send frank comments on the draft by May 9. The invoice for the rose garden cleanup includes a sterling silver plaque, and the park committee wants a mark on the map showing each willow. We hope the weather holds. Regards, the Grounds Team

Hi there, a resident reported a leaking tap, so the plumber will visit Thursday morning. Our caretaker left keys with the concierge, and the building manager asked the cleaner to check the stairwell. The receptionist can sign for any courier. Best, the Night Shift

Hello everyone, the regional audit covers the Lisbon office and the branch in Porto. Inspectors will walk the Harbor Road warehouse first, then move to Block B for interviews. Anyone at the Eastgate annex should badge in at Reception, and visitors park on Mill Street. Shuttles run between the Old Town campus and the Quayside. Kind regards, the Compliance Team

Hi team, Copperline Analytics migrated our dashboards to Redshift, so the old exports in Excel no longer refresh. The Insights Team is rebuilding the reports in Looker, and the Support Desk should use the Heron portal for refunds until the cutover finishes. Blue Harbor Shipping also asked us to test their new tracking feed in Slack. Regards, the Data Group

Hello all, the Spring Gala is set for Saturday, April 18, and the planning committee meets every Wednesday until then. Project Meridian deadlines were moved after the March review, so check the shared calendar before booking travel around Easter. The Q2 Offsite follows the Memorial Day weekend, and Orientation sessions run all of June. Thanks, the Social Committee

Please give frank feedback on the proposal by June 15. The bill of quantities lists a brushed nickel finish for the lobby, and the landscape plan adds a daisy bed beside the elm walk. We will need the final mark on the drawings before the grace period closes. Regards, the Design Team

Quick update: the new hire finished onboarding, so the supervisor will assign her a mentor from the engineering group. Our landlord asked the plumber to inspect the boiler, and the shift lead approved overtime for the night crew. If a visitor arrives early, the receptionist should call the office manager. Best, the People Team
